subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should #95612 remain a separate live service-context Claude CLI authentication investigation, or be collapsed into the expired-token recovery-copy work tracked by #97553/#98036?
rationale: The reporter's traces show a stronger failure than missing re-auth guidance, but the decisive difference requires macOS LaunchAgent, Claude CLI OAuth, and live OpenClaw MCP proof that automation cannot infer safely from source alone.

options.title: Keep separate pending live service proof
options.body: Treat #95612 as the canonical managed gateway/service-context 401 investigation and request the focused live comparisons before accepting a code fix.

options.title: Collapse after recovery-copy PR lands
options.body: If maintainers believe the 401 is only expired-token handling, retest after one #97553 PR lands and close only if the managed run succeeds or the reporter confirms equivalence.

options.title: Close as external setup only after confirmation
options.body: Close like #95367 only if the reporter confirms GUI/keychain reauthentication or another external setup action fixes the managed path.

recommendation.title: Keep separate pending live service proof
recommendation.body: Treat #95612 as the canonical managed gateway/service-context 401 investigation and request the focused live comparisons before accepting a code fix.
